records.summary: VM becomes unstable and fails to start after reboot
records.description: The customer reported that the VM repeatedly failed to start and sometimes became unresponsive after reboot. Investigation found that the VM metadata was corrupted. Recovery requires administrator access to repair the metadata from the management plane.

comments.body: Reporter said the VM did not start after reboot and the console showed inconsistent instance information.
Support checked the VM status and confirmed that normal guest OS recovery steps did not resolve the issue.
Platform team found corrupted VM metadata and confirmed that administrator permission is required to repair it from the management plane.

records.summary: VM becomes unstable and fails to start after reboot
records.description: The customer reported that the VM repeatedly failed to start and sometimes became unresponsive after reboot. First-CS escalated the ticket without checking the existing rebuild runbook. The platform team later confirmed that the documented VM rebuild procedure would likely have resolved the issue at first contact.

comments.body: Reporter said the VM did not start after reboot and the console showed intermittent boot failures.
First-CS escalated the ticket before checking the VM rebuild runbook or trying the documented recovery procedure.
Platform team reviewed the case and found that the standard rebuild procedure was available in the runbook and should have been attempted before escalation.
Customer completed the rebuild and confirmed that the VM started normally after the documented procedure was applied.
